decisions.briefing: Macro index data was unavailable today so the broad market direction is unconfirmed, but several screened stocks still show strong multi-signal technical confirmation. We used the 3 open slots to diversify into WOR, EFXT, and LOPE, moving away from an already tech-heavy portfolio, while holding all existing positions since none hit stop-loss or profit targets.

market_education.summary_en: Today's market data feed was unavailable, so NASDAQ and S&P 500 movement could not be confirmed. In the absence of a clear macro signal, we relied on individual stock-level technical confirmation (RSI, MACD, moving averages) to guide new positions rather than broad index momentum. No news headlines were available to cite for today.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤數據無法取得，納斯達克及標普500的漲跌未能確認。在缺乏明確宏觀訊號的情況下，我們改以個股層面的技術指標（RSI、MACD、均線）作為建倉依據，而非依賴大盤動能。今日並無可引用的新聞標題。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When broad market data isn't available, investors can still make informed decisions by looking at individual stock signals like RSI, MACD crossovers, and moving averages. Requiring multiple signals to agree (not just one) reduces the chance of acting on false signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當大盤數據無法取得時，投資人仍可透過個股的技術指標（如RSI、MACD黃金交叉、均線）做出判斷。要求多項指標同時確認，而非僅憑單一訊號進場，能降低誤判的風險。
